limits: Do not treat AGI/ASI/superhuman system labels as a singularity gate.
An AI model, user product, orbital compute demo, data center expansion or satellite bandwidth claim is not a complete systemic regeneration cycle.
An increased R_sys without causal alpha_AI, chain closure, appropriate external dependency accounting and persistence is insufficient.
Systemic loop closure does not require zero human labor, no natural resources, or thermodynamic closure.
Sigma_sys does not imply Sigma_civ; a beneficial AI without regenerative closure is also not Sigma_sys.
One part of the network/media stack is neither whole-world compute nor fully available authorized AI service.
Requests and economic final demand are different measurements.
Any threshold applied to system-state dimensions must be preregistered in an external study; this code has no threshold or empirical certification.
Historical definitions must be preserved and subsequent scientific definitions appended, not overwritten.
No unknown future year or physically impossible capability inferred from missing data.
All negative outcomes and human core work remain visible.
Provenance schema validates claims, not authenticity or external evaluator independence.
